audience: product and support teams that turn call recordings and videos into searchable transcripts in AssemblyAI

useCases.title: Transcribe a recording from a public URL
useCases.text: Start a transcription for a publicly reachable audio or video URL. Read the transcript until its status is completed. AssemblyAI bills the audio processed.

useCases.title: Read a finished transcript by paragraph
useCases.text: List recent transcripts, then read the paragraphs of a completed one. Start times and speakers appear where available.

useCases.title: Get subtitles from a transcript
useCases.text: Read a completed transcript as subtitle text in SRT or VTT format.

useCases.title: Find where a word comes up
useCases.text: Count where given words or phrases occur in a completed transcript, with the timestamp of each match. Phrases cannot contain commas.
